what: On first open, the big number (00~100) at the bottom left of the dark panel walks to the right with progress — progress approaches the larger of the time share (up to .8 over 1.6s) and the share actually received (images·fonts) by .12 per frame (holding at .92 while still loading), and once everything is in it climbs to 100 with a .6s cubic out. Then the ‹Loading 00%›, wordmark and number strip leave in .5s, the center symbol scales 250× over 1s after .5s to cover the screen (cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)), and 1.6s later the panel lifts away in .7s and fires fx:done

options.min: Length (s) for the time share to reach .8, default 1.6
options.finish: Time in seconds to rise to 100 after fully loaded, default .6 — 0 for instant
options.hold: Seconds from the symbol starting to grow until the panel clears away, default 1.6 — shorten it for screens opened often, like in an app
options.out: Duration (s) for the panel to clear — match --fx-out in css, default .7
options.--fx-walk: Width the number travels (via style), default 89% (original phone 81%)
options.--fx-fade / --fx-out: Text exit and panel retract duration, default .5s · .7s
options.[data-fx-part=track]: A band where numbers walk — the [data-fx-part inside it=num] goes from left to right
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Center symbol — grows at the end to cover the screen

use:
Loading 0%

00
note: With reduced motion, hide the panel and fire fx:done right away. The color covering the screen as the symbol grows is the symbol’s fill (usually currentColor = Panel text color) — the next screen is revealed from that color
